name: Post-shock next-session fade: dose-response in shock size within p90+ (ten ETFs, 2023-06 → 2026-07)
thesis: Within top-decile shocks, the next-session intraday fade return increases with shock size.

data.events: the 798 HYP-111a events (data/research/hyp111/hyp111a_trades.parquet: sym, t, t1, s, naive_net)
data.daily: data/cache/daily_universe — for the size measure only

size_measure.x: trailing-252 percentile rank of |r_t| among the prior 252 sessions' |r| (t excluded), in [0.90, 1.0]
size_measure.why_rank: comparable across instruments and vol levels; the raw |r| is not

outcome.fade: −s × (close_15:55 − open_09:30)/open_09:30 on session t+1, minus 3.0 bp — i.e. exactly −(HYP-111a naive_net)

primary.pass: bin means weakly increasing B1 ≤ B2 ≤ B3 AND OLS slope of fade on x has date-block 95% CI excluding 0 from above

secondary.note: the operator's stated form — 'after a sharp move down, fade harder when bigger'

descriptive: per-bin mean, CI, n, per instrument

statistics.abort: any bin with < 40 events (primary) / < 25 (secondary) → INCONCLUSIVE for that claim

verdict_ladder.FLAT: slope CI includes 0 or bins not monotone

floor_note_standing: Written before any floor-gated fade prereg is run: a selective strategy that sits in cash is measured on deployed capital; an always-on overlay on calendar time. HYP-111a's 0.05%/event-day floor was the always-on form. Any fade prereg that adopts per-deployed-capital must cite this note and seal the denominator before its run. This hypothesis has no floor gate.

operator.prior: expects a dose-response (message 2026-09-02, not formally stated)

claude.most_likely_failure: B3 (p99+) has ~60-80 events and its CI swallows the slope; B1 vs B2 flat

abort.no_scan: no search across bin edges, size measures or outcomes
